findings.missionHUDLegibility: All 10 selected room/mission HUD blocks are readable at 1440×900.
findings.shownSignsAndReadouts: FAR DOCK (41), STORE ACCESS (45), LOADING RECEIVER (49) and upper TRANSFER B / STOPPED lines (44) readable.
findings.heroes: Ivory projector visible in all 10; gold cargo visible in 45/47/49/50. No missing texture or earlier alternating face-triangle defect observed in the shown faces. No held/straddle/all-angle/contact claim from this batch.
findings.portals: Small portal views shown in 42/46/49/50 have no evident full-screen white pop or missing portal texture in these static poses. Oblique geometry occlusion and small images limit edge/AA/clipping assessment.
findings.presentation: Broad ribbed/grid grey panels and near-black masses are flatter/cooler and more repetitive than retained family references. Warm local strips/pools add hierarchy; target parity remains unestablished.
excludedClaims: whole-target parity or all-room final art acceptance
